ex: Skim the article before reading it in detail.
exzh: 在细读之前先浏览一下这篇文章。

ex: Protect your skin from the strong summer sun.
exzh: 保护你的皮肤免受夏日烈日伤害。

ex: Do not skip breakfast before an important exam.
exzh: 重要考试前不要不吃早饭。

ex: She wore a long skirt to the evening party.
exzh: 她穿着一条长裙去参加晚会。

ex: The doctor examined the skull X-ray carefully.
exzh: 医生仔细查看了头骨X光片。

ex: A new skyscraper now stands beside the river.
exzh: 河边现在矗立着一座新的摩天大楼。

ex: Business is slack during the hot summer months.
exzh: 炎热的夏季几个月里生意冷清。

ex: He slammed the door and left the room angrily.
exzh: 他砰地关上门，生气地离开了房间。

ex: Young people often use slang on social media.
exzh: 年轻人在社交媒体上常用俚语。

ex: She slapped the mosquito on her bare arm.
exzh: 她拍死了胳膊上的蚊子。

ex: The museum tells the story of freed slaves.
exzh: 博物馆讲述了被解放奴隶的故事。

ex: Slavery was abolished in that country long ago.
exzh: 那个国家很久以前就废除了奴隶制。

ex: The warm room made all the students sleepy.
exzh: 温暖的房间让所有学生都困了。

ex: He rolled up his sleeves and started working.
exzh: 他卷起袖子开始干活。

ex: The dancer had a slender figure and graceful moves.
exzh: 那位舞者身材苗条，动作优雅。

ex: Cut the bread into thin slices, please.
exzh: 请把面包切成薄片。

ex: The children love to slide down the snowy hill.
exzh: 孩子们喜欢从雪坡上滑下来。

ex: There is a slight difference between the two plans.
exzh: 这两个方案之间有细微差别。

ex: The room was slightly colder than I expected.
exzh: 房间比我预想的稍微冷一点。

ex: She stayed slim by walking every morning.
exzh: 她每天早晨走路，保持了苗条身材。

ex: Be careful not to slip on the wet floor.
exzh: 小心别在湿滑的地板上滑倒。

ex: He put on his slippers and opened the door.
exzh: 他穿上拖鞋去开门。

ex: The road is slippery after heavy rain.
exzh: 大雨过后路面很滑。

ex: The company changed its advertising slogan last year.
exzh: 公司去年更换了广告口号。

ex: The house stands on a gentle green slope.
exzh: 这座房子坐落在一片平缓的绿坡上。

ex: His sloppy handwriting makes the notes hard to read.
exzh: 他潦草的字迹让笔记很难辨认。

ex: Put the coin into the slot on the machine.
exzh: 把硬币投入机器上的投币口。

ex: Please speak more slowly so everyone understands.
exzh: 请说得慢一些，好让大家都听懂。

ex: The city plans to rebuild the old slum area.
exzh: 这座城市计划重建旧贫民窟地区。

ex: He gave me a sly smile and said nothing.
exzh: 他冲我狡黠地一笑，什么也没说。
